Require Import strictness.cbpv.typing.

Require Export strictness.cbn.typing.

Fixpoint translateType {n} (T : CbnTy n) : CompTy n * attrs n :=
    match T with
    | TUnit => (CF VUnit, lazyvector)
    | TSum γ1' T1 γ2' T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1) := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2) := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VSum (VThunk (γ1' γ+ γ1) A1) (VThunk (γ2' γ+ γ2) A2)), lazyvector)
    | TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VProd (VThunk (γ1 γ+ γ1') A1) (VThunk (γ2 γ+ γ2') A2)), lazyvector)
    | TArrow γInput q γ T1 T2 =>
        let '(A, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(B, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CAbs (q C+ γ2' None) (VThunk (γInput γ+ γ1') A) (down_ty B), γ γ+ (γ↓ γ2'))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : cbnContext n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) =>
        let '(τ, γ) := (Γ i) in
        let '(B, γ') := translateType τ in
        VThunk (γ γ+ γ') B.

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e : Term n) : Comp n :=
    match e with
    | tVar i => cForce (vVar i)
    | tAbs e => cAbs (translateTerm e)
    | tApp e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | tLet t1 t2 =>
        cLet (cRet (vThunk (translateTerm t1))) (translateTerm t2)
    | tUnit => cRet vUnit
    | tSeq e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (vVar var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | tPair e1 e2 =>
        cRet (vPair (vThunk (translateTerm e1)) (vThunk (translateTerm e2)))
    | tInl e => cRet (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tInr e => cRet (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tSplit e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit
                (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tCase e e1 e2 =>
        cLet (translateTerm e)
            (cCase (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tSub e => cSub (translateTerm e)
    end.

Theorem translation_correct_returner :
    forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) e T A γ',
    cbnWt γ Γ e T ->
    (CF A, γ') = translateType T ->
    CWt γ (translateContext Γ) (translateTerm e) (CF A).

Require Export strictness.cbn.syntax.

Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing.

Definition cbnContext n : Type := fin n -> CbnTy n * attrs n.

Definition cbnContext_insert {n} (T : CbnTy n) (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) : cbnContext (S n) :=
    (Lazy T↑ T, Lazy .: γ) .: (fun fn => let '(τ, γ) := Γ fn in (Lazy T↑ τ, Lazy .: γ)).

Inductive cbnWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) : Term n -> CbnTy n -> Prop :=
  | CBN_T_Var i A γ' :
    (A, γ') = Γ i ->
    γ = (γ' <- Strict @ i) ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tVar i) A

  | CBN_T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ tUnit TUnit

  | CBN_T_Let q γ1 t1 t2 T1 T2 T :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 T1 ->
    cbnWt (q .: γ) (cbnContext_insert T1 γ1 Γ) t2 T2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T2 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tLet t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Pair γ1 γ2 t1 t2 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 T1 ->
    cbnWt γ2 Γ t2 T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tPair t1 t2) (TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2)

  | CBN_T_Inl γ' γ'' t1 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t1 T1 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tInl t1) (TSum γ' T1 γ'' T2)

  | CBN_T_Inr γ' γ'' t2 T1 T2 :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t2 T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tInr t2) (TSum γ'' T1 γ' T2)

  | CBN_T_Seq t1 t2 T γ1 γ2 :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 TUnit ->
    cbnWt γ2 Γ t2 T ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSeq t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Split t1 t2 q1 q2 γ1 γ2 γ1' γ2' T1 T2 T T':
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TProd γ1' T1 γ2' T2) ->
    cbnWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2))
      (cbnContext_insert (Lazy T↑ T1) (Lazy .: γ1') (cbnContext_insert T2 γ2' Γ)) t2 T' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy (down_cbnTy T') ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSplit t1 t2) T

  | CBN_T_Case t1 t2 t3 q1 q2 γ1 γ2 γ1' γ2' TL1 TR1 T T2 T3:
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TSum γ1' TL1 γ2' TR1) ->
    cbnWt (q1 .: γ2) (cbnContext_insert TL1 γ1' Γ) t2 T2 ->
    cbnWt (q2 .: γ2) (cbnContext_insert TR1 γ2' Γ) t3 T3 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T2 ->
    T = down_cbnTy T3 ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tCase t1 t2 t3) T

  | CBN_T_Abs q γInput γ' t T1 T2 :
    cbnWt (q .: γ') (cbnContext_insert T1 γInput Γ) t T2 ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tAbs t) (TArrow γInput q γ' T1 T2)

  | CBN_T_App t1 t2 q γ1 γInput γ3 T1 T2 T2' :
    cbnWt γ1 Γ t1 (TArrow γInput q γ3 T1 T2') ->
    cbnWt γInput Γ t2 T1 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ3 ->
    T2 = down_cbnTy T2' ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tApp t1 t2) T2

  | CBN_T_Sub γ' t T :
    cbnWt γ' Γ t T ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    cbnWt γ Γ (tSub t) T
.
Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_S n (S n) (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n))) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

Inductive attr : Type :=
    | Lazy
    | Strict
    | Unknown.

Definition attr_le (c1 c2 : attr) :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Unknown, _ => True
    | Lazy, Lazy => True
    | Strict, Strict => True
    | _, _ => False
    end.

Notation "c1 C<= c2" := (attr_le c1 c2) (at level 60).

Definition attr_stricter (c1 c2 : attr) :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Strict, _ => True
    | Unknown, _ => True
    | _, Lazy => True
    | _, _ => False
    end.

Notation "c1 'S<=' c2" := (attr_stricter c1 c2) (at level 60).

Definition attr_add (c1 c2 : attr) : attr :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Lazy, c2 => c2
    | c1, Lazy => c1
    | _, Strict => Strict
    | Strict, _ => Strict
    | _, _ => Unknown
    end.

Notation "c C+ d" := (attr_add c d) (at level 60).

Definition attrs n : Type := fin n -> attr.

Definition ren_env {A n n'} (γ : fin n -> A) (ξ : fin n' -> fin n) : fin n' -> A :=
    fun fn => γ (ξ fn).

Definition lazyvector {n} : attrs n := fun _ => Lazy.

Definition strictvector {n} : attrs n := fun _ => Strict.

Definition attr_vector_add {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : attrs n :=
    fun fn => γ1 fn C+ γ2 fn.

Notation "c γ+ d" := (attr_vector_add c d) (at level 60).

Definition attr_vector_le {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : Prop := forall fn,
    γ1 fn C<= γ2 fn.

Notation "γ1 γ<= γ2" := (attr_vector_le γ1 γ2) (at level 50).

Definition attr_vector_stricter {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : Prop := forall fn,
    γ1 fn S<= γ2 fn.

Notation "γ1 γS<= γ2" := (attr_vector_stricter γ1 γ2) (at level 50).

Definition down_attrs {n} (γ : attrs (S n)) : attrs n := ren_env γ shift.

Notation "'γ↓' γ" := (down_attrs γ) (at level 85).

Definition env_set {n} {A : Type} (ϕ : fin n -> A) (i : fin n) (a : A) :=
    fun fn => if fin_eqb i fn then a else ϕ fn.

Notation "ϕ <- a @ i " := (env_set ϕ i a) (at level 70).

Definition down_env_until' {A m} k (γ : fin (k + m) -> A) : fin m -> A :=
    ren_env γ (shift_p k).

Definition up_fin_until {n} m (H : n <= m) : ren n m :=
  fun i => eq_rect _ fin (shift_p (m - n) i) _ (Nat.sub_add n m H).

Definition down_env_until {A n} (γ : fin n -> A) m (H : m <= n) : fin m -> A :=
  fun i => γ (up_fin_until n H i).

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Require Export strictness.common.attributes.

Inductive CbnTy (n : nat) : Type :=
  | TUnit : CbnTy n
  | TProd (γ1 : attrs n) (T1 : CbnTy n) (γ2 : attrs n) (T2 : CbnTy n) : CbnTy n
  | TSum  (γ1 : attrs n) (T1 : CbnTy n) (γ2 : attrs n) (T2 : CbnTy n) : CbnTy n
  | TArrow (γInput : attrs n) (q : attr) (γ : attrs n) (T1 : CbnTy n) (T2 : CbnTy (S n)) : CbnTy n
.

Arguments TUnit {n}.

Arguments TProd {n}.

Arguments TSum {n}.

Arguments TArrow {n}.

Definition up_map {n m} (ξ : attrs n -> attrs m) : attrs (S n) -> attrs (S m) :=
  fun (γ : attrs (S n)) => fun (fn : fin (S m)) => match fn with
  | None => γ None
  | Some f => ξ (ren_env γ shift) f
  end.

Fixpoint map_cbnTy {n m} (ξ : attrs n -> attrs m) (T : CbnTy n) : CbnTy m :=
  match T with
  | TUnit => TUnit
  | TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2 => TProd (ξ γ1) (map_cbnTy ξ T1) (ξ γ2) (map_cbnTy ξ T2)

Require Import strictness.cbpv.typing.

Require Export strictness.cbn.typing.

Fixpoint translateType {n} (T : CbnTy n) : CompTy n * attrs n :=
    match T with
    | TUnit => (CF VUnit, lazyvector)
    | TSum γ1' T1 γ2' T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1) := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2) := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VSum (VThunk (γ1' γ+ γ1) A1) (VThunk (γ2' γ+ γ2) A2)), lazyvector)
    | TProd γ1 T1 γ2 T2 =>
        let '(A1, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(A2, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CF (VProd (VThunk (γ1 γ+ γ1') A1) (VThunk (γ2 γ+ γ2') A2)), lazyvector)
    | TArrow γInput q γ T1 T2 =>
        let '(A, γ1') := translateType T1 in
        let '(B, γ2') := translateType T2 in
        (CAbs (q C+ γ2' None) (VThunk (γInput γ+ γ1') A) (down_ty B), γ γ+ (γ↓ γ2'))
    end.

Definition translateContext {n} (Γ : cbnContext n) : context n :=
    fun (i : fin n) =>
        let '(τ, γ) := (Γ i) in
        let '(B, γ') := translateType τ in
        VThunk (γ γ+ γ') B.

Fixpoint translateTerm {n} (e : Term n) : Comp n :=
    match e with
    | tVar i => cForce (vVar i)
    | tAbs e => cAbs (translateTerm e)
    | tApp e1 e2 =>
        cApp (translateTerm e1) (vThunk (translateTerm e2))
    | tLet t1 t2 =>
        cLet (cRet (vThunk (translateTerm t1))) (translateTerm t2)
    | tUnit => cRet vUnit
    | tSeq e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSeq (vVar var_zero) ((ren_Comp shift) (translateTerm e2)))
    | tPair e1 e2 =>
        cRet (vPair (vThunk (translateTerm e1)) (vThunk (translateTerm e2)))
    | tInl e => cRet (vInl (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tInr e => cRet (vInr (vThunk (translateTerm e)))
    | tSplit e1 e2 =>
        cLet
            (translateTerm e1)
            (cSplit
                (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up2_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tCase e e1 e2 =>
        cLet (translateTerm e)
            (cCase (vVar var_zero)
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e1))
                ((ren_Comp up_ren') (translateTerm e2)))
    | tSub e => cSub (translateTerm e)
    end.

Theorem translation_correct_returner :
    forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) e T A γ',
    cbnWt γ Γ e T ->
    (CF A, γ') = translateType T ->
    CWt γ (translateContext Γ) (translateTerm e) (CF A).

sed '"'/"'^Theorem translation_correct_returner/,$d'"' Task.v > \""'$check_dir/ReturnerCheck.v" &&
cat >> "$check_dir/ReturnerCheck.v" <<'"'EOF'
Definition sample_context : cbnContext 2 :=
  fun _ => (TUnit, lazyvector).

Definition sample_attrs : attrs 2 :=
  lazyvector <- Strict @ var_zero.

Lemma sample_cbn : cbnWt sample_attrs sample_context (tVar var_zero) TUnit.
Proof.
  eapply CBN_T_Var with (γ' := lazyvector).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma target_requires_equality :
  (forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : cbnContext n) e T A γ',
    cbnWt γ Γ e T ->
    (CF A, γ') = translateType T ->
    CWt γ (translateContext Γ) (translateTerm e) (CF A)) ->
  sample_attrs = (sample_attrs γ+ lazyvector).
Proof.
  intro preserve.
  pose proof
    (preserve 2 sample_attrs sample_context (tVar var_zero) TUnit
              VUnit lazyvector sample_cbn eq_refl) as H.
  cbn in H.
  inversion H as [| | V B γ1 γ2 HV Hattrs | | | | | |]; subst.
  inversion HV as [i A HA Hvar | | | | |]; subst.
  cbn in HA.
  injection HA as H2.
  subst.
  exact Hattrs.
Qed.

Lemma pointwise_equality :
  forall i, sample_attrs i = (sample_attrs γ+ lazyvector) i.
Proof.
  intros [i|]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Print Assumptions target_requires_equality.
Print Assumptions pointwise_equality.
Fail Definition sample_conversion :
  sample_attrs = (sample_attrs γ+ lazyvector) := eq_refl.
Eval cbv in sample_attrs.
Eval cbv in (sample_attrs γ+ lazyvector).
EOF
rocq compile -R . strictness \""'$check_dir/ReturnerCheck.v"'

I verified in Rocq 9.1.0 that the theorem would imply `a = (a γ+ lazyvector)` for `a := lazyvector <- Strict @ var_zero` in a two-variable context. The CBN variable rule accepts `a` directly, and the CBPV force rule requires the equality.

The two attribute vectors agree at each index, but their function normal forms differ. A closed proof of that equality in the supplied axiom-free context would require the sides to be convertible.
